title: Validation of Reproductive Autonomy and Contraceptive Autonomy Scales Among Egyptian Women
brief_summary:
This study aims to:

1. To validate Arabic version of the reproductive autonomy scale among married women in reproductive age group (15-49 year) in Assiut.
2. To validate Arabic version of the contraceptive autonomy scale among married women in reproductive age group in Assiut
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Currently married women within reproductive age group (15-49 years)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Current pregnant women, breast feed women (till 6 months), intension to get pregnant within the next 12 months and husband is traveler.
study_population: Currently married women within reproductive age group (15-49 years) coming for immunization of their children.
